ROUND 2 RE-OPENED THE `c.` SUBSET ONLY, carried as the separate common-gender-inexpressible row (228): content.morphology is closed at 9 values and never expresses common gender, so the seeding cannot recover it. The m./f./pl. leaks remain discarded on the reasoning above.
